intro: Five threads moving drug development this week — ranked, with a point of view and the sources behind it. Refreshed every Monday.

narratives.headline: KRAS has become a four-modality pile-up — and it's reaching pivotal stage
narratives.detail: The ASCO 2026 tail has KRAS converging from four directions at once: allele-specific small molecules (zoldonrasib's G12D Phase 3 now enrolling alongside daraxonrasib, sotorasib and adagrasib), J&J's $1B Firefly Bio ADC platform, and the standing neoantigen-vaccine lane — all pressing on the same target across PDAC and NSCLC simultaneously. None of it is de-risked: per pancreatic cancer's Phase 3 graveyard, every read this cycle is entrant- or phase-advance movement, not validated efficacy. The crowding is the story; ESMO in September is where it gets tested.

narratives.headline: Oral SERDs are quietly conceding 1L monotherapy — and winning everywhere adjacent
narratives.detail: Roche dropped three giredestrant Phase 3 reads in a single cycle: pionERA in 1L monotherapy failed against letrozole (PFS HR 0.89), while adjuvant lidERA cleared its bar (IDFS HR 0.65) and the post-CDK4/6 everolimus combination hit (PFS HR 0.56). It's the clearest in-period signal yet that the class — elacestrant, camizestrant and imlunestrant included — is consolidating around adjuvant and combination positioning rather than the AI-displacement fight it keeps losing.

narratives.headline: CD19 antibodies just broke into frontline DLBCL
narratives.detail: Tafasitamab's frontMIND read is the first CD19 antibody to win in frontline DLBCL (PFS HR 0.75), landing alongside a fresh epcoritamab OS cut versus immunochemotherapy and the standing mosunetuzumab-plus-pola benchmark (PFS HR 0.41). After several cycles of bispecific and CD-targeting dominance in relapsed/refractory disease, the frontline door is now open too. The entrant tail — sonrotoclax, tazemetostat, allo-NK CD19 — is still early.

narratives.headline: FRα ADCs have graduated from entry to head-to-head
narratives.detail: AZD5335's Phase 3 in ovarian is a direct head-to-head against Elahere (mirvetuximab) — not another me-too entry but a bid to displace the benchmark itself, with sofetabart and BL-B01D1 filling in the pipeline behind it. That intra-class H2H is the surest sign a modality has saturated its entry phase, the same maturation arc FcRn (myasthenia gravis) and IL-23 p19 (Crohn's) have already walked. ESMO is the likely readout inflection.

narratives.headline: WEE1 cracks platinum-resistant ovarian — the first non-ADC, non-PARP mechanism to
narratives.detail: Azenosertib posted a 39.1% ORR in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer, edging past the 32.4% SORAYA mirvetuximab reference and becoming the first credible non-ADC, non-PARP mechanism to clear that bar this period. It's a single entrant-stage readout, not a franchise. But in a setting defined by ADCs, a genuinely new mechanism clearing the threshold is worth tracking before ESMO crowds the lane.
